worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.summary: Splash a ring of thick venom around the user: opponents already poisoned lose Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed together, while anyone not poisoned is only soaked and unaffected. A deep drench cuts 2 stages but covers less ground and is slower; a shallow one cuts 1 stage with a wider, quicker splash.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.use.0: Poison first, then reap: soften a poisoned foe in three stats at once
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.use.1: Catch several poisoned enemies in one splash
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.use.2: Stick to one tough poisoned target and drench it twice as hard
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.descriptio: Only a poisoned (or badly poisoned) foe inside the venom ring loses %1$s stages of Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed; the venom reaches %2$s blocks around the user.
Anyone not poisoned is only soaked and takes no penalty.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.deep.on: Deep drench: %1$s stages off each stat, but a smaller radius and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.deep.off: Shallow drench: 1 stage off each stat, with a wider splash that is quicker and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.timing: After %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.venomdrench.preference: On: 2 stages off each stat, but the splash radius is multiplied by 0.8 with a 2-tick longer wind-up and 12 ticks more cooldown. Off: 1 stage off each stat, radius multiplied by 1.25, quicker and cheaper.
The companion walks in to drench only against a threat within this distance; larger means engaging from farther.
Cast only when this many poisoned non-allies stand inside the splash radius, so the move is not wasted; 1 means one poisoned foe is enough.
